rich_text.text: Requirements for the notarized passport translation
You need a valid international passport
at the very end of the notarized passport translation, it must say in Georgian "Translated from English into Georgian" (not from Russian)
the spelling of your full name in the notarized translation must be the same as in your registration certificate, passport and bank statements
Once our documents were translated correctly except for a wrong date in one field → we pointed out the mistake and got a corrected translation within 5 minutes.
check every detail in the finished documents against the original
Tell the translator, and be sure to check:
At the notary you will receive a copy of your passport bound (with a red ribbon) to the Georgian translation and the notarization.
Not every notary has a translator, so you simply visit notary offices and ask whether they can translate a Russian passport into Georgian and notarize it.
